entries.name: 柴犬 · 只轉根節點試作（未通過）
entries.author: Quaternius
entries.upstream_version: Ultimate Animated Animals / July 2021 / Drive revision 2022-02
entries.warning: A 是本輪只轉根節點的失敗對照；B 是四足世界接觸修正候選。新增兩段為行走中的 90° 弧線轉向；未製作起停或任意時刻直走／轉向混合。其餘 12 段保留前版，9 段未驗接地。

modifications.scale_note: Uniform whole-character gameplay size, not measured biological accuracy; no anatomy or clothing resize.
modifications.body_head_tail: native source motion; original topology, skin, material bytes preserved
modifications.motion_method: New authored foot-contact targets matching native gait phase; existing native IK, world displacement, 60 Hz FK bake. Not new mocap/training.
modifications.untouched_original_clips: other 9 clips retain original sampler bytes under uniform scale; no contact approval
modifications.baseline_status: New root-only arc trial using previous corrected straight Walk; not a previous published turn or approved motion

turns.paw_orientation: Native Idle IK/FF orientation held throughout stance; native swing orientation eases in and out; original skin weights retained.
turns.contact_policy: Native four-paw phase offsets; world anchor fixed during each stance; smooth swing between successive curved-path anchors; foot heading held to midstance heading.
